hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton hook shared by all graduated Pons v2 meme pools. Charges a configurable protocol + creator fee on every swap via afterSwap using the return-delta mechanism, accumulating fees per pool in pending buckets. A trusted sweep operator can later convert memecoin-denominated fees to quote currency via internal pool swaps and distribute proceeds to protocol, creator, and a buyback-and-lock vault.
